intervals.label: construction for the dark-matter search
intervals.note: Start is the date of the earliest source that says the chamber 'is being built' (Snowmass white paper, July 2022); arXiv:2310.00442 (September 2023) says the collaboration 'is constructing' it. No installation date is published.
intervals.quote: A second functionally-identical detector with a focus on radiopure construction is being built for SBC's first dark matter search at SNOLAB.

placements.note: SNOLAB (hall not asserted); installation date unknown. The SNOLAB underground-lab point is used.
placements.quote: The Scintillating Bubble Chamber (SBC) collaboration is constructing a 10~kg liquid argon (LAr) bubble chamber at SNOLAB called SBC-SNOLAB having the main objective of detecting dark matter.

target_mass.quote: The Scintillating Bubble Chamber (SBC) collaboration is constructing a 10~kg liquid argon (LAr) bubble chamber at SNOLAB called SBC-SNOLAB having the main objective of detecting dark matter.

target_medium.quote: a 10~kg liquid argon (LAr) bubble chamber at SNOLAB

summary.plain: The cleaner twin of SBC-LAr10, a 10-kg superheated liquid-argon chamber being built for SNOLAB to search for light dark matter.
summary.technical: Functionally identical to SBC-LAr10 with radiopure construction: 10-kg liquid-argon bubble chamber, ~10 ppm Xe dopant, 48 FBK VUV SiPMs, two quartz jars, liquid CF4 hydraulic fluid.

technology.quote: consisting of LAr doped with on the order of 10~ppm Xe, 48 FBK VUV silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs), the SiPM electronics, two quartz jars, and liquid CF$_4$ used as an hydraulic fluid
technology.value: Scintillating liquid-argon bubble chamber (LAr with ~10 ppm Xe, 48 FBK VUV SiPMs, two quartz jars, liquid CF4 as hydraulic fluid)
